title: UserCredential.password accepts plaintext silently at startup
description: reader/src/config.rs UserCredential.password is a plain String with no validation that it is a bcrypt hash. An operator who puts a plaintext password in [auth.users] gets no startup error; bcrypt::verify silently returns false so the account never authenticates. The user sees only 481 Authentication failed, indistinguishable from a wrong password. Maintenance consequence: silent operator misconfiguration with no actionable error.
